about: Blocky case terrain grid for Jakarta (ascending geometry). Layer values are x10 integers (mm); null = masked. Row 0 = north. Written by tools/process_jakarta.py.
block_text: one block = 2×2 NISAR interferogram pixels of 80 m ≈ 160 m
